description.value: A Haida-owned campground on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, with North Beach's vast tidal sands and Naikoon Park trails steps away; tent sites share a central flush bathroom, but water is non-potable and the experience is intentionally rustic and off-grid.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, Indigenous-owned campsite on Traditional Haida lands with tent sites, RV sites, and longhouse cabins; phone numbers on the website ((778) 702-0359 and (250) 626-9489) match OSM exactly. The RV campsite page explicitly states 'No Wi-fi and Limited Cell Service is Available,' contradicting OSM's internet_access=wlan tag, and the site is described throughout as off-grid with limited electricity subject to outages. Showers and reservations are positively confirmed by the website; potable water is partially confirmed (tap water is non-potable but drinking-water jugs are provided to guests).
concerns: OSM name 'Hiellen Village Campsite' differs from the website's primary branding 'Hiellen Village Longhouses' — may cause confusion for directory users.

OSM tag internet_access=wlan contradicts the RV campsite page, which explicitly states 'No Wi-fi and Limited Cell Service is Available'; the site is off-grid and electricity is described as limited and subject to outages.
OSM capacity=6 appears to reflect only the six small longhouses; the full property also includes RV sites, tent sites, and a large group longhouse, so total capacity is understated.
OSM address field is empty; physical street address (Towhill Rd, Masset, BC V0T 1R0) taken from website contact page — contact_confirmed.address set to null as there is no OSM value to compare.
OSM wheelchair=yes tag is not clearly corroborated by the website; the RV campsite page only says 'Ask About Accessibility,' which is weaker than a positive confirmation.
Contact page contains unfilled Lorem Ipsum placeholder text, suggesting the website is not fully finalized.
Active construction of 7 new longhouses is noted on the contact page and may affect the guest experience during visits.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active campsite with tent and RV sites on Haida Gwaii operated by a First Nations council; touring cyclists riding the island would benefit from this listing given its proximity to North Beach and Naikoon Provincial Park trails.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address hiellenlonghouses@gmail.com found on website contact page; not present in OSM. The site is explicitly and repeatedly described as rustic and off-grid — relevant context for touring cyclists who may need to plan around limited water, power, and connectivity.

wow_evidence: Haida-owned campground on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii... operated by a First Nations council
